gripOrHq.title: Rush Hour
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, access three additional cards from R&D. You cannot use noisy icebreakers during the run.

gripOrHq.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

gripOrHq.title: Promises, Promises
gripOrHq.rulesText: The next time you access an agenda this turn, score 1 additional agenda point.

gripOrHq.title: Prearranged Drop
gripOrHq.rulesText: The next time you access an agenda this turn, gain [6].

rig.title: HQ Mole
rig.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from HQ. Use this ability only when accessing cards from HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

ice.title: Vacuum Link
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.

encounteredIce.title: Vacuum Link
encounteredIce.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.
